countingNote: Interaction and context-switch estimates are task-model ranges based on the inspected UI, not analytics.

tasks.entryPoint: Plan > Setup > Network, then Plan > Inventory
friction: Project is visible but Scenario/Version identity is not persistent
cell readiness and network selection are split between drawer and map
empty/initial network guidance is not one continuous task path
tasks.discoverability: Medium-high; Plan labels are clear, but saving and lineage arrive later.

steps: Select an active cell or network subset
friction: Import and per-cell editing are in one long drawer
provenance is visible as a source label but not emphasized
large lists need a clearer result count and bulk follow-up
tasks.discoverability: High; Import is a visible Inventory action.

tasks.entryPoint: Plan > Setup, Plan > Inventory, and Simulate > Propagation
friction: Common and research/reference inputs are visually contiguous
per-cell overrides are separated from plan defaults
Plan changed invalidation is visible but source Run identity is not
tasks.discoverability: High for core controls; medium for knowing which level owns a setting.

tasks.entryPoint: Header Project menu or Plan > Setup > Scenario workspace
friction: Scenario and Version actions have duplicate entry points
hierarchy requires an explanation
comparison source identity is not carried into the global header
tasks.discoverability: Medium; visible once Setup is opened but not part of the map’s persistent context.

tasks.entryPoint: Header Run Sector or Simulate > Propagation
steps: Open Results or inspect the map
friction: Run is clear, but current Version/Run identity is not
research cards can distract from the canonical Run
map/result state is not one named object
tasks.discoverability: High; Run Sector is the strongest action in the header.

steps: Choose Interference, Building entry, or RF Diagnostics
Compare evidence with the active result
friction: Diagnostic choices are spread across Analyze and map state
historical/current distinction is weak
research/reference panels compete with operational diagnosis
tasks.discoverability: Medium; map evidence is intuitive, deeper diagnosis requires domain knowledge.

tasks.entryPoint: Simulate > Propagation optimization controls or Results optimization view
friction: Search policy is specialist language
optimization shares space with propagation/reference tooling
result source and target Version need stronger identity
tasks.discoverability: Medium; Auto-Optimize Sector is visible, but the conceptual workflow is not one compact surface.

friction: Objectives, scores, raw metrics, ranking, and feasibility are dense
Recommended, Selected, and Pareto are easy to conflate
application target Scenario/Version is not always persistent
tasks.discoverability: Medium-low for new users; strong for users who know optimization terminology.

tasks.entryPoint: Review > Report, Run History detail, or Scenario revision detail
friction: There are multiple entry points
artifact terminology appears in the default flow
source confirmation is inside detail rather than persistent
tasks.discoverability: High under Review; medium when starting from a result or Run.

tasks.entryPoint: Review > Run history or Scenario revision inspector
steps: Rerun or apply a retained solution
Generate a historical Report if needed
friction: Historical state is not visually persistent after leaving Run history
Run detail uses implementation-heavy metadata
applying a solution needs stronger destination confirmation
tasks.discoverability: High for users who inspect Review; low from the default map unless they know Review exists.

crossTaskFindings.mostCommonContextSwitch: Map → stage/drawer → Review/history → source Version/Scenario → map
crossTaskFindings.mostCommonAmbiguity: Which Scenario/Version produced the current or historical result?
crossTaskFindings.bestCurrentEntryPoint: Header Run Sector for current computation
crossTaskFindings.weakestCurrentEntryPoint: Persistent source context after a result or historical Run is opened
crossTaskFindings.highestLeverageChange: Make current/stale/historical state and lineage visible without changing the existing task graph.
